stages.title: Story Completion
stages.subtitle: Finish the Leonida campaign
stages.blurb: Play the main campaign from Gone Fishing through the final credits left to right. Every story trophy here unlocks automatically as the chapters roll by, so there is no grinding or collectible hunting yet. Go in loose and enjoy it — this is the only stage where you can freely free-roam and form your own route.
focus: Follow the main story missions only; side content waits until later stages.
Story, chapter and final-mission trophies (Just Like Paradise → You Gotta Know When to Get Off) pop automatically.
If a story mission offers a named alternative objective, do it the first time — several feed later crime trophies.
Mission trophies (Break the Bank → Snow Storm) unlock from the story heist missions.

stages.title: Collectibles & World
stages.subtitle: Sweep every region of Leonida
stages.blurb: Once the story opens up the full map, tour the state region by region and sweep every activity and collectible in one organised trip: meditation spots, collectible card sets, WAiNK locations, the vehicle codex, all 52 areas of Leonida, the garage properties and vehicle registration. Backtracking the map is the single biggest time sink, so avoid it.
focus: Sweep region by region instead of hopping around the map.
Meditation, card sets, WAiNK and vehicle discovery all count toward 100%, so do them together.
Buy all 8 garage properties before your vehicle registration spree.

stages.title: Strangers & Side Content
stages.subtitle: Help the locals before they vanish
stages.blurb: Stranger strands and fishing challenges dry up as the story advances, so clear every named stranger you meet while they are still on the map. Do all the Strangers & Freaks strands to their final mission, beat the fishing challenge, and finish an arcade game for Stick Fiddler.
focus: Complete each stranger's full strand to its last mission — partial arcs are lost after the credits.
Do the stranger and side content trophies while the missions are still live.
Baited My Tackle and Stick Fiddler are both easy to overlook late.

stages.title: Activities & Shared Economy
stages.subtitle: Grind activities alongside normal play
stages.blurb: Grind the repeatable activities while you free-roam rather than saving them for a final push: stunts, every activity type, gold shooting ranges, drone races and races. Then let the shared-economy trophies — laundering Marked Bills and spending in shops — build up naturally through the single-player and online economy.
focus: Cunning Stunts (with Gold adds for 250 stunts) is the longest grind — chip away at it constantly.
Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, not just silver.
Treat Yo Self and Dime on the Dollar tick up from normal spending; no dedicated grind needed.

stages.title: Crime & Combat Cleanup
stages.subtitle: Heists, gangs and combat
stages.blurb: Clean up the crime and combat trophies. Most are repeatable, but a handful are missable — grab those early and carefully before the cops clamp down. Then keep the counts ticking over: Combat Focus takedowns, the tank fight, a stealth jewelry heist, five bank vaults, an armored truck and all nine gang operations.
focus: Do every missable trophy first — they can slip away if you are careless.
Rob five bank vaults, one by one and escape each time.
The stealth jewelry heist is unforgiving: stay unseen for the whole job.

stages.title: Platinum Run
stages.subtitle: 100% completion and the last gold
stages.blurb: Finish the clean-up run for 100% completion (A Long Road), confirm no trophy was missed, and the platinum unlocks once the rest of the list is complete. Save Vice Got a Price! for the very end — there is nothing special to do beyond holding every other trophy.
focus: Reach 100% completion for A Long Road.
Sweep the checklist for any unearned trophy before you claim the platinum.
Vice Got a Price! pops last, automatically.
